sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reciters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(display_name)) > 0), "arabic_name" TEXT, "attribution" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_info" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "theme" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system' CHECK (theme IN ('system', 'light', 'dark')), "reduced_motion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reduced_motion IN (0, 1)), "network_policy" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'wifi' CHECK (network_policy IN ('wifi', 'any')), "default_reciter_id" TEXT REFERENCES reciters(id), "daily_goal_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 300000 CHECK (daily_goal_ms >= 0), "preferences_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (preferences_version > 0), "updated_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "surahs" ("number" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (number BETWEEN 1 AND 114), "arabic_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(arabic_name)) > 0), "transliteration" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(transliteration)) > 0), "search_aliases" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(search_aliases)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recording_editions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "reciter_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reciters(id), "riwayah" TEXT, "source_notes" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audio_assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "edition_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recording_editions(id), "surah_number" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES surahs(number), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0), "url" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (url LIKE 'https://%'), "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER CHECK (duration_ms > 0), "byte_size" INTEGER CHECK (byte_size > 0), "sha256" TEXT CHECK (length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), "availability" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (availability IN ('unavailable', 'published', 'retired')), CHECK(availability <> 'published' OR(duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND byte_size IS NOT NULL AND sha256 IS NOT NULL)), UNIQUE(edition_id, surah_number, version));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_passages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES audio_assets(id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0), "start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (start_ms >= 0), "end_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (end_ms - start_ms >= 1000), "repeat_mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (repeat_mode IN ('finite', 'continuous')), "play_count" INTEGER, "gap_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (gap_ms IN (0, 2000, 5000, 10000)), "speed" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0 CHECK (speed BETWEEN 0.5 AND 2.0), "note" TEXT, "created_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_utc_ms >= created_utc_ms), CHECK((repeat_mode = 'finite' AND play_count IS NOT NULL AND play_count BETWEEN 1 AND 999)OR(repeat_mode = 'continuous' AND play_count IS NULL)));

CREATE TRIGGER passage_insert_bounds BEFORE INSERT ON saved_passages BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Passage requires verified duration and valid bounds') WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audio_assets WHERE id = NEW.asset_id AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND NEW.end_ms <= duration_ms);END

CREATE TRIGGER passage_update_bounds BEFORE UPDATE ON saved_passages BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Passage requires verified duration and valid bounds') WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audio_assets WHERE id = NEW.asset_id AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND NEW.end_ms <= duration_ms);END

CREATE TRIGGER asset_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON audio_assets BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Recording bytes and identity are immutable') WHERE OLD.id <> NEW.id OR OLD.edition_id <> NEW.edition_id OR OLD.surah_number <> NEW.surah_number OR OLD.version <> NEW.version OR(OLD.sha256 IS NOT NULL AND(NEW.sha256 IS NOT OLD.sha256 OR NEW.byte_size IS NOT OLD.byte_size OR NEW.duration_ms IS NOT OLD.duration_ms OR NEW.url IS NOT OLD.url));END
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorites" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('surah', 'passage')), "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(type, target_id));

CREATE TRIGGER favorite_insert_target BEFORE INSERT ON favorites BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Unknown favorite target') WHERE(NEW.type = 'surah' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM surahs WHERE CAST(number AS TEXT) = NEW.target_id))OR(NEW.type = 'passage' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved_passages WHERE id = NEW.target_id));END
CREATE TRIGGER favorite_update_target BEFORE UPDATE ON favorites BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Favorite target is immutable') WHERE NEW.type <> OLD.type OR NEW.target_id <> OLD.target_id;END
CREATE TRIGGER passage_delete_favorite AFTER DELETE ON saved_passages BEGIN DELETE FROM favorites WHERE type = 'passage' AND target_id = OLD.id;END
CREATE TRIGGER surah_delete_favorite AFTER DELETE ON surahs BEGIN DELETE FROM favorites WHERE type = 'surah' AND target_id = CAST(OLD.number AS TEXT);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "downloads" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES audio_assets(id), "relative_path" TEXT CHECK (relative_path <> '' AND relative_path NOT LIKE '/%' AND relative_path NOT LIKE '%..%' AND relative_path NOT LIKE '%:%' AND relative_path NOT LIKE '%\%'), "native_task_id" TEXT, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued', 'running', 'verifying', 'verified', 'failed', 'cancelled')), "received_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (received_bytes >= 0), "verified_sha256" TEXT, "updated_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK(state <> 'verified' OR(relative_path IS NOT NULL AND verified_sha256 IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TRIGGER download_insert_verified BEFORE INSERT ON downloads BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Download integrity mismatch') WHERE NEW.state = 'verified' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audio_assets WHERE id = NEW.asset_id AND byte_size = NEW.received_bytes AND sha256 = NEW.verified_sha256);END

CREATE TRIGGER download_update_verified BEFORE UPDATE ON downloads BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Download integrity mismatch') WHERE NEW.state = 'verified' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audio_assets WHERE id = NEW.asset_id AND byte_size = NEW.received_bytes AND sha256 = NEW.verified_sha256);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playback_checkpoints" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('full', 'passage')), "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES audio_assets(id), "passage_id" TEXT REFERENCES saved_passages(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "current_pass" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (current_pass > 0), "remaining_count" INTEGER CHECK (remaining_count >= 0), "source_position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (source_position_ms >= 0), "settings_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(settings_snapshot)), "updated_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TRIGGER checkpoint_insert_bounds BEFORE INSERT ON playback_checkpoints BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Invalid checkpoint asset/position') WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audio_assets WHERE id = NEW.asset_id AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_position_ms <= duration_ms);SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Checkpoint passage asset mismatch') WHERE NEW.passage_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved_passages WHERE id = NEW.passage_id AND asset_id = NEW.asset_id);END

CREATE TRIGGER checkpoint_update_bounds BEFORE UPDATE ON playback_checkpoints BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Invalid checkpoint asset/position') WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audio_assets WHERE id = NEW.asset_id AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_position_ms <= duration_ms);SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'Checkpoint passage asset mismatch') WHERE NEW.passage_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved_passages WHERE id = NEW.passage_id AND asset_id = NEW.asset_id);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "listening_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES audio_assets(id), "passage_id" TEXT REFERENCES saved_passages(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "started_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_utc_ms" INTEGER CHECK (ended_utc_ms >= started_utc_ms), "played_wall_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (played_wall_ms >= 0), "speed" REAL NOT NULL CHECK (speed BETWEEN 0.5 AND 2.0), "completion_reason" TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_activity" ("local_date" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(local_date) = 10), "timezone_policy" TEXT NOT NULL, "played_wall_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (played_wall_ms >= 0), "goal_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (goal_ms >= 0), "qualified" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (qualified IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES listening_sessions(id), "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES daily_activity(local_date), "played_wall_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (played_wall_ms > 0), "utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL);
